candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order /v1/orders fails with 502; the gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200, low latency), so the fault originates at the order service.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; cannot confirm whether order fails due to its own dependency (inventory/payment/postgresql) or internal error.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502 on /v1/checkout paired with client-side 502 errors calling order /v1/orders, while readyz stays 200 and checkout p95 latency is ~94ms (not latency-bound). Fault is downstream at order; exact order-side cause needs order evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs for /v1/orders showing error cause and status
Order service metrics (dependency operations, latency, error rates) for inventory/payment/postgresql
Postgresql/redis connection pool and timeout metrics to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
